test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
How may triangle are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57a984e044e91be1a0a29aaa7211c37a14b3762045e55fe867a81122ee256f0a.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure are shown below:

1) As there are marked 9 parts (same shape), therefore (9 × 2) = 18 triangles

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e7b086d4513bf65ceebd8bc851bff711118043070d61d3cc798d930d4b071d7.png] 

2) Number of triangles = 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7318a85d99464109a9a72c3e889b24e6516fe8d269984e1a1d0cfb3030a27e37.png] 

3) Number of triangles = 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c38ffce1a638ca20aafff139b0a0edc5157b88a316105ffe9a7c587df791c8ff.png] 

Thus, as marked there are a total of (18 + 3 + 9) = 30 triangles in the given figure.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
